articles.title: Argentina mark World Cup win over England with 'National Football Teams Day'
articles.summary: The Argentine Football Association announces 15 July as National Football Teams Day to mark Argentina's 2026 World Cup semi-final victory over England.

articles.title: Players who turned World Cup heroics into big transfers
articles.summary: BBC Sport looks back at some of the players whose standout performances at the World Cup earned a big transfer.

articles.title: Brighton latest: Baleba picks up ankle injury
Players union slams FIFA 'abuse of power' as UEFA doubles down on boycott
articles.summary: The world players' union FIFPRO has condemned Gianni Infantino's "abuse of presidential power" and called for change at the top of FIFA following his botched World Cup stake sale plans.
